## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests
- [ ] User-visible text uses translation keys (no hardcoded strings)
- [ ] UI changes are keyboard-accessible and have screenshots (light, dark, phone width)
- [ ] Database changes are in a new migration and work on SQLite and Postgres
- [ ] README and `.env.example` updated if config or architecture changed
- [ ] No new outbound network calls by default
